unconditional.summary: Free use at any scale, including operating a service, with no further condition.

no-competing-service.summary: Free use except operating the Software, or a fork of it, as a service competing with the Licensor's own offering; that use is Paid Use at the Licensor's Published Price.

no-third-party-hosting.summary: Free use except providing the Software to third parties as a hosted or managed service; that use is Paid Use at the Licensor's Published Price.

noncommercial.summary: Free for non-commercial use; commercial use is Paid Use at the Licensor's Published Price.

seat-limited.summary: Free in production up to a stated seat/device/user threshold, unlimited free non-production use; production use beyond the threshold is Paid Use at the Licensor's Published Price.

decentralized.summary: Free use with no Paid Use. Disputes go to exclusive online ICC arbitration, individual claims only, with each party's liability limited to US$1 in value, payable in money or the project's native token.

paid.summary: Free to read the source. Every other use, by anyone, is Paid Use at the Licensor's Published Price, which may be zero or cover only a trial period. Most useful as the scope of one Component.

components.overlap: a file that more than one Component covers belongs to the Component listed first
components.spdx: LicenseRef-UFL-3.5-<L>[.<l>-<name>]... where <L> is the scope letter of the rest of the Software and <l>-<name> is each Component's scope letter and name; letters U C H N S D P as in spdxSuffix; example LicenseRef-UFL-3.5-U.P-snifrig-fix
